corePsychologicalUnlock.title: The Cognitive Velocity Gap
corePsychologicalUnlock.statement: Keyboards are the single greatest bottleneck of modern intellect. The average human thinks at 400+ WPM, speaks at 160 WPM, but types at a sluggish 40 WPM.
corePsychologicalUnlock.challenge: Indian knowledge workers view speech-to-text as sloppy Siri dictation or a rough audio note.
corePsychologicalUnlock.unlock: Position Wispr Flow as an executive-grade neural drafting engine: you speak naturally, and Wispr formats it instantly into polished Slack messages, Linear tickets, or PRDs with zero editing.

quickPrompts: What is your unfair advantage in growth?

responses.why wispr flow: Wispr Flow solves the single biggest bottleneck in knowledge work: the cognitive velocity gap. We think at 400+ WPM, speak at 160 WPM, and type at 40 WPM. In India's hyper-dense developer and startup ecosystem (Bengaluru, Gurgaon), voice dictation that writes final-draft code and prose is a massive unfair advantage. I want to build the distribution engine that makes Wispr Flow the default tool on every Indian builder's laptop.
responses.lead-gen: At Kratos Energy, I owned the outbound acquisition funnel. I engineered cold email infrastructure, refined copy hooks to spike open rates, and handled direct client calls to convert top-of-funnel leads into pipeline meetings. I bring that same relentless outbound hustle to acquiring Wispr Flow enterprise pilots and campus partners.
responses.unfair advantage: My unfair advantage is the convergence of technical computer science depth, quantitative trading rigor, and creator distribution instincts. I don't just write marketing copy; I build multi-agent LLM systems, understand statistical data down to the variance, and know how to hook an audience on YouTube and LinkedIn.
responses.contact: You can reach me directly via email at narayanrakhechaau@gmail.com, call me at +91 8999392326, or connect on LinkedIn. I am based in India and ready to execute immediately for Wispr Flow.
